description: This file defines the PHP class HTMLPurifier_Injector_SafeObject, which extends the HTMLPurifier_Injector base class. It implements functionality to insert and manage 'param' elements within 'object' HTML tags for sanitization purposes, ensuring only allowed parameters are included and certain security attributes are added.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_SafeObject
classes.description: Class that adds security parameters to object tags and manages the insertion of 'param' elements within 'object' tags during HTML purification.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the injector with configuration and context, calling the parent prepare method.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Handles the processing of HTML tokens for 'object' and 'param' tags; adds security params and filters out unauthorized params.

methods.name: handleEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of 'object' tags, managing internal stacks accordingly.
